privacy.ownerAccess: Owner management is available through your signed-in session or the secure HttpOnly recovery capability.
privacy.publicAccess: Anyone with this URL can read the fields the owner chose to publish. Call audio is never stored.

owner.title: Manage this record
owner.detail: Publishing, visibility, expiration, slug, and content changes apply to this record. Participant names should only be published with consent.

consent.publicActive: Allow anyone with the URL to view this record
consent.publicWarning: Publishing makes this record and its participant information available at its public URL. Confirm participant consent before saving.
consent.privateNote: This record remains private until you explicitly publish it.

notices.updated: Record updated. A changed slug now uses its new public URL.

errors.privateTitle: This record is private or does not exist.
errors.privateDetail: Only the owner session or a browser holding the record’s secure recovery capability can open a private record.
errors.invalidMetadata: Custom metadata must be valid JSON.

confirm.publish: Publish this record? Its contents and participant information will be available at the public URL after you confirm.
confirm.revoke: Revoke public access? This record will become private and the public URL will stop working.
